title: Self-check after every journal write
problem: On 11/10 a partial close was journaled as an exit, which would have dropped the real exit from the ledger. It was caught by reading the code, not by a check.
change: New `selfcheck` command compares the journal, positions file, metrics, both ledgers and the risk cap. Every check-in runs it before committing (lesson L010).
measure: Any drift between the files is reported by selfcheck in the same run; no ledger correction is found by hand in the next 10 trading days.

title: Daily health check inside the reflection
problem: Every check-in fires into one session. A missed or failed run is only noticed if someone looks.
change: The 14:12 reflection lists the scheduled tasks (last run status, enabled, next run), confirms the day's expected outputs exist (watchlist, entry decision, journaled exits, selfcheck ok) and turns anything missing into a heal proposal the same day.
measure: Every missed or failed run is reported on the day it happens.

title: Score every name at two wing widths
problem: Wing width has been chosen by feel (0.9x to 2.2x the straddle on 11/10) and it sets both the max loss and the breakevens.
change: The daily scoring prices each name with wings at 1x and at 2x the straddle. The reflection tallies which width did better per dollar of max loss.
measure: After 30 scored names there is a wing-width recommendation backed by numbers.

note: adds about 15% to the scoring cost

title: Compute the entry gate in code
problem: The engine's caps are still at v1. The live gate (v1.1 to v1.3) is applied by reading a prompt, so a slip is possible and nothing cross-checks it.
change: Bring the engine config up to v1.3 and run each candidate through `score` at entry. A disagreement between the engine and the manual gate blocks the entry until it is explained.
measure: Every entry carries an engine decision record; no unexplained disagreement. Target: done by Fri 2026-11-13.

title: Get Robinhood to accept multi-leg orders from the agent
problem: Every agent multi-leg order is rejected with an approval message although approvals are off. Legging works, but it adds leg risk, took 3 to 5 minutes per fly, forced a bid-side fill on RGTI and left FLY with uneven wings.

title: Independent watchdog for missed exits (alert only)
problem: All check-ins fire into this one session. If it does not wake at 06:45, an earnings fly sits unmanaged and nobody is told.
change: A second scheduled task at 07:25 PT starts a fresh session, looks only at the broker account, and sends a push notification if a short option position opened on an earlier day is still open. It never places orders. About 20-30k tokens a day.
measure: A simulated missed exit produces an alert within 45 minutes.

title: Replay 100 past earnings events
problem: The rule hypotheses have 1 to 8 observations each. At two live trades and a few scored names a day they need weeks to reach a verdict.
change: Price 100 events from the last four weeks from option history (about 2M tokens, about 10 minutes), with the fixes from the pilot: exit 30 minutes after the open, two wing widths.
measure: Each rule hypothesis has at least 10 observations; a first recommendation on wing width and on the intraday gate.

title: Project P/L the evening after each report and score it at the open
problem: The 14:46 after-hours read gave ranges by feel (+$5 to +$30, +$40 to +$125). Nothing recorded the assumptions, so a miss could not be traced to price, volatility or fills.
change: A pricing model (`projection.py`) values the fly from the after-hours spot and the volatility left after the report; the next morning `project-check` splits the error into spot, volatility and quotes. Both go in projections.jsonl.
measure: After 10 scored projections the median absolute error of the base case is at most $25 a contract; otherwise the model is revised.

title: Switch off the long-straddle side until it shows an edge
problem: The rules buy a straddle when the edge ratio is 1.25 or more. In the replay 8 names qualified: the long straddle lost on 6, -$755 in total before costs (H009, 6 for, 2 against). The engine ranks buys and sells together, so a straddle can take a slot.
change: Set the buy side aside (no long straddles) and keep scoring it on paper. Selling rules unchanged.
measure: On the next 8 scored names with edge 1.25 or more: if long straddles still lose on balance it stays off; if they win at least 2 to 1 it comes back to Brad.

title: Use the at-the-money implied move when the body strike is off-center
problem: The engine reads the implied move from the raw straddle at the nearest strike. On a coarse strike grid the body sits off the money and the straddle holds intrinsic value, which overstates the implied move and understates the edge ratio (TFC: 4.5% raw, 4.2% at the money).
change: In the engine, convert the body straddle to its at-the-money equivalent before computing the edge ratio, as replay.py does. Do it together with P004.
measure: For a body strike 2% off the money the engine's implied move matches the at-the-money value within 0.1 percentage points (unit test).

title: Intraday premium selling (same-day expiry), live only when the premium is rich
problem: Brad, 2026-11-11 07:09 PT: 'lets do some day trading for the iv crush/theta decay'. Day trades are allowed now (the pattern-day-trader rule ended 2026-06-04). Theta is only large enough to day trade in options that expire the same day. On 2026-11-11 the SPY same-day straddle priced a 0.36% move for the rest of the session while 10-day realized vol was 30% against 17% implied; QQQ, IWM and the large caps look the same. Selling that has no cushion.
change: Rules v1.6 (intraday): (1) Paper-trade one SPY same-day iron fly every session at about 07:15 PT (wings about 1x the straddle), scored from 5-minute bars at the reflection. (2) Go live with 1 contract only when the same-day straddle is at least 1.15x the 10-session average move over the same hours (the earnings edge-ratio idea applied intraday), max loss 150 or less, counted inside the total risk cap. (3) Exits: take profit at 25% of the credit, cut at credit + 60% of the remaining width, flat by 12:15 PT, never held to the close. (4) Own breaker: the live pilot pauses after 2 losses in a row or -150 in total, and a pilot loss also counts in the account's losing-streak breaker. (5) Review after 10 paper sessions or 5 live trades.
measure: After 10 sessions: paper P/L after a 7 cent round-trip cost per leg, and whether the 1.15x filter separates winning days from losing days. Live only continues if both are positive.
